signals.name: Intel Corporation
signals.label: Congress + insider overlap
signals.detail: Nancy Pelosi's household disclosed a $500K-$1M INTC stock buy plus long-dated call options in July 2026 (part of a broader congressional pattern -- 27 members, ~100 disclosed trades, ~$4.8M bought vs. $806K sold in 2026); separately, Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan made an open-market purchase of roughly $10M of INTC shares (105,263 shares, ~$95 average) in August 2026.
signals.takeaway: Independent buying from both a sitting member of Congress and Intel's own CEO in the same stretch is a rare double-signal of conviction, though neither buyer has disclosed-trade price protection the way retail does.

signals.name: SpaceX (Space Exploration Technologies Corp.)
signals.label: Congress cluster + retail buzz
signals.detail: At least six members of Congress (Cisneros, Timmons, McGuire, Meuser, Moskowitz, James) disclosed SPCX purchases within weeks of its June 2026 IPO; the ticker remains one of the most-mentioned names on r/wallstreetbets (97 mentions, trending) months later even as an insider lockup released up to 911.5M shares in August.
signals.takeaway: Bipartisan congressional buying at the IPO lines up with sustained retail chatter, but the looming insider lockup-expiry supply is a real counterweight worth tracking.

signals.name: GameStop Corp.
signals.label: Insider cluster + retail darling
signals.detail: CEO Ryan Cohen has made four separate open-market purchases since September 10, 2026 -- most recently 700,000 shares on October 2 at $24.41 -- each at a higher price than the last, bringing trailing-12-month insider buying to $81.3M against just $1.5M of insider selling. GME remains Reddit's most-discussed single stock (404 mentions in one day; ~1,252/day over 30 days), still outpacing every retail peer.
signals.takeaway: Insider buying into strength (not just dips) combined with durable retail obsession is a rare alignment, though quarterly revenue is still falling 18.7% y/y.

signals.name: Nike, Inc.
signals.label: Exec cluster buying + bullish retail chatter
signals.detail: Nike CEO Elliott Hill and Apple CEO/Nike board director Tim Cook have both been personally buying NKE stock in clusters (Dec 2025 and again April 10-13, 2026, ~$1M each purchase), even as congressional trading in the name has been net-selling. Separately, NKE is currently the single most-mentioned, most-bullish ticker on r/wallstreetbets (1,369 mentions).
signals.takeaway: Two of Nike's most senior insiders buying in the open market at the same time as a retail sentiment surge suggests a turnaround narrative is gaining believers across very different investor bases.

signals.name: Bloom Energy Corporation
signals.label: Congress disclosure + retail copy-trade surge
signals.detail: Nancy Pelosi's household's July 2026 Bloom Energy stock-and-options disclosure (filed ~Aug 24) triggered an immediate retail copy-trading wave -- a dedicated 'Pelosi Tracker' app reported over 20,000 users mirroring the position -- plus a same-day sympathy rally in FuelCell Energy and Plug Power.
signals.takeaway: This is a case where the congressional disclosure itself manufactured the retail signal rather than the two forming independently -- worth treating as a reflexive, disclosure-driven flow rather than organic multi-source conviction.

signals.name: Opendoor Technologies Inc.
signals.label: Insider buying + meme-stock retail mania
signals.detail: CEO Kasra Nejatian has made repeated open-market purchases (100,000 shares at $4.88 in May 2026, ~$100,000 more in August) even as OPEN became 2026's breakout meme stock -- up as much as 500%+ in a month on r/wallstreetbets-fueled volume peaking near 1.9 billion shares traded in a single session.
signals.takeaway: CEO buying underpinning a genuine retail mania is unusual -- most meme-stock surges have no insider participation -- but the stock's extreme volatility (round-trips of 50%+ in hours) means this is a high-risk, not a steady-conviction, overlap.
